name: Air Quality Testing at Saratoga Village
description:
This dataset contains air quality testing records from Saratoga Village, covering 264 sampled rows across 17 columns. Each record includes a date and sample location, with up to three measurement events per visit. For each event, the data captures the time, volatile organic compound (VOC) concentration in parts per million, temperature in Fahrenheit, humidity, and any field observations. Sample locations include areas such as the basement, main area, plaster shop, compactor room, and storage room, and the records span eight dates in September 2018.

The data could be used to track VOC levels over time and across locations, examine relationships between VOC concentrations and temperature or humidity, identify periods or sites with elevated readings, and flag measurements that may exceed health thresholds. It could also support environmental health assessments, indoor air quality investigations, or remediation planning for the site.
